summary: 15 tests cover the TDD anchor exactly. Shared make_status_error / make_connection_error fixtures correctly construct anthropic SDK exceptions with httpx.Response/Request. No real network calls. SDK exception coverage matches Decision 5 (8 outage + 2 per-article + parse/schema branches).

findings.title: Shared exception fixtures — correct constructor pattern
findings.description: make_status_error builds APIStatusError subclasses with required (message, response, body) keyword args. make_connection_error handles APIConnectionError (request kwarg) and APITimeoutError (positional request) signatures separately. Avoids the documented TypeError pitfall.

findings.title: Token observability assertion via caplog
findings.description: test_happy_path_returns_valid_dict asserts substring presence of input_tokens / output_tokens / latency_ms / model in log records. Matches AC19 — substring assertion not exact format match — robust to format-string changes.

findings.title: Two emoji safety-net branches tested
findings.description: test_title_without_emoji_gets_safety_net covers 🚀 (релиз/launch) and 🏆 (legends/tour) branches. Adequate coverage of the cascade per task spec ('минимум 2 ветки content regex').

findings.title: test_load_prompt_subdir_then_flat_fallback uses internal _MODULE_DIR knob
findings.description: Test monkeypatches claude_transcreation._MODULE_DIR to redirect the flat-fallback resolution. Slightly fragile — if the module ever stops using _MODULE_DIR for the flat fallback, the test is silently skipped of meaningful coverage. Mitigated because the alternative (full sys.path / file system staging) would be more brittle.
findings.resolution: Accepted. Test name + comment make the intent clear. Module contract documents _MODULE_DIR as internal but stable.

findings.title: Auto-reset _PROMPT_CACHE fixture
findings.description: Autouse fixture clears _PROMPT_CACHE before/after each test → no test pollution across the cache.

verification.isolation: All tests use mocks; no network. health_check tested implicitly via smoke verification, not unit (acceptable — health_check is a 5-line wrapper around already-tested SDK call).
